collection.description: A child asks why hair keeps getting longer after a haircut.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why hair keeps getting longer after a haircut.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a healer, explains that hair grows from roots in the skin.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks why some hair grows longer than other hair.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) learns that people choose different styles for many reasons.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) decides they like their current hairstyle.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult) explains a traditional haircut without insisting everyone follow it.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks to try a different style when older.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) asks how dyes change hair color and hears about safe choices.
